scope: Independent read-only Rust source/API/input-only driver/build-harness peer review; supplements earlier native review.
result: No actionable defect found against the frozen active-value contract and explicit native/host premises.
semantic_review: The actual exported function tests full u64 tag==2 before parity;0x102 and high-word+2 remain ordinary even append records. The slice suffix is not visited after the sentinel.

Even tags append unchanged u64 payloads to existing vectors or create the absent key with an empty sequence first. Initial present-empty vectors and unrelated keys survive. No float conversion, normalization, deduplication or reordering occurs.
Odd tags update only when dex_byte==3, and BTreeMap::insert gives last-write replacement. Odd records do not create sample entries; even records do not touch fallback entries.
u64 key typing and BTreeMap iteration give unsigned ordering in the driver. Borrowed records cannot be mutated by the library; separate &mut map borrows enforce safe storage separation.

The chosen owned map abstraction deliberately ends at native0x222b480. Scheduler coverage, producer construction, outer min pairing, native allocator/B-tree identity, cleanup lifetime and allocation/panic/rollback behavior are excluded consistently in lib docs/README/pre-source contract.
All eight handwritten source tests were read, including all256 dex bytes, full-width sentinel, raw NaN/sign payloads, unrelated state, entry presence and per-call stop scope.
driver_review: Read full driver: it imports the real library and contains no expected-file/oracle/source-fixture access. Its only runtime input is stdin; it serializes complete returned maps, not just checksums.
Input IDs are opaque ordered Cnnnnnn, checked against row position. Five input fields contain dex byte, initial maps and ordered record data; no expected answer label is supplied.

Map parser requires strictly increasing unsigned u64 keys and distinguishes absent '-' from an existing key with empty values. Record parser does not sort or deduplicate records. Words are canonical lowercase16hex; dex is2hex.
Output uses BTreeMap unsigned order and exact16hex raw bits; samples preserve element order/entry presence. Malformed input exits2, separate from target semantics.
build_review: Read complete21024B build.py and pins/source freeze. It admits exact five source files, frozen harness identities, original static/pre-source manifests, manifest/lock with zero dependencies and no build script/workspace, then re-admits source after runs.

Actual Cargo metadata checks one package/member, no dependencies/source and exactly lib+test targets. Copied source/driver snapshots are compared before and after; mutants alter only the declared copied library.

All child commands have an explicit environment, fresh Cargo home, offline/locked Cargo, no inherited wrappers/flags except unchanged HOME, pinned RUSTC/RUSTDOC and canonical-path remapping. Canonical Cargo ancestors are audited, including /private/tmp after /tmp resolution.
Toolchain bin/lib content is pinned before/after; selected compiler/linker/SDK identities are recorded. HostOS/dyld/fullSDK hermeticity is correctly excluded.

Parent alone reads expected bytes, exact comparator catches full-byte/line/ID/order/value differences, and every command stdout/stderr is retained content-addressed. No expected-file substitution for observed output.

Ten semantic source mutations are applied with unique exact text coordinates, built as real release crates, linked to the unchanged driver and required to mismatch unchanged expectations. A compile failure aborts rather than counting as sensitivity.
Baseline tests/builds run debug+release; separate clean-directory rebuilds run both. Raw rlib/client equality is reported without masks and is not silently required/assumed.
limitations: No Rust build, captured binary, target evaluator, socket or target action was run by this reviewer.

Author/root build outputs were not yet finalized when this source review ran; this review does not assert their test counts/results or compiled mutant outcomes. Parent/author own those actual receipts.
97 installed toolchain payload files were independently rehashed; selected linker/SDK byte checks and actual build command outcomes remain harness/root-run responsibilities.
8 comparator controls and10 mutation coordinates were exercised through the inspected pure harness functions only; this is not mutant compilation.
Public standard-library BTreeMap/Vec semantics are used as safe abstract containers; no native memory-layout/allocator equivalence or component gate follows.
mutation_policy: No source/packet edits, no Git. Only this session review artifact was written.
